data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name Antonius, Tony is a name of Greek origin that means 'priceless'. It is a popular variant of Anthony, which means 'priceless, inestimable'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
